goal: Establish persistence (PostgreSQL + Drizzle) and secure authentication (Auth.js) so all later features have identity + storage.

depends_on_outputs_from: ProjectArchitectureSetupAgent: /lib/env.ts with validated DATABASE_URL, /db directory exists

tasks.title: Implement Drizzle schema + enums + constraints
steps: Create /db/schema.ts with tables: users, driver_locations, voice_messages, stress_signals
Add PostgreSQL enums: voice_message_status (delivered, listened), stress_signal_status (active, resolved)
Add foreign keys per spec
Add indexes per spec (driver_locations.user_id, driver_locations.updated_at, stress_signals.status+created_at)
verification: Schema exports are importable by other modules

tasks.title: Configure Drizzle connection + migrations
steps: Create /db/index.ts with Drizzle client using DATABASE_URL from /lib/env.ts
Create drizzle.config.ts
Add package.json scripts: db:generate, db:migrate (drizzle-kit generate/push/migrate as chosen)
Generate migrations and commit /db/migrations
verification: npm run db:migrate succeeds against a running PostgreSQL

tasks.title: Export inferred types
steps: Export InferSelectModel and InferInsertModel types for each table where useful
Ensure types align with later Zod constraints
outputs: Exported Drizzle inferred TypeScript types from /db/schema.ts
verification: TypeScript compilation passes and other files can import types

must_provide: Example connection usage snippet with Drizzle client

tasks.title: Implement Auth.js (NextAuth v5) credentials auth
steps: Create /auth.ts with Credentials provider
Implement authorize() using UserLoginSchema validation and bcrypt compare
Use JWT session strategy; include user.id and user.email in token/session
Add TS module augmentation so session.user.id is typed
verification: TypeScript session includes user.id without casting

tasks.title: Add Auth.js route handler
steps: Create /app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts using Auth.js handler export
Confirm callback URLs align with NEXTAUTH_URL
verification: Login endpoints respond and set session cookie

tasks.title: Implement registration endpoint
steps: Create /app/api/auth/register/route.ts
Validate body via validateOrThrow(UserRegisterSchema, body)
Hash password with bcrypt (salt rounds 12)
Insert user into DB with unique email constraint handling (return 409 on conflict)
Return 201 with safe payload (no password_hash)

tasks.title: Protect routes with middleware + server helpers
steps: Create middleware.ts to protect /app/(protected) routes
Create /lib/auth-helpers.ts with getServerSession wrapper and requireAuth()
Ensure server-side handlers can use requireAuth() consistently
verification: Unauthenticated access to /(protected) redirects to /login or returns 401 (as designed)

must_provide: How to register a user (curl example)
How to log in and verify session
List of protected route patterns and expected behavior

integration_checkpoint.name: Checkpoint B — DB + Auth Gate
must_pass: POST /api/auth/register creates user with bcrypt hash
Login succeeds and session contains user.id
Protected routes under /(protected) are blocked when unauthenticated
manual_verification: Register a user, then sign in, then visit a protected page route and confirm access

stop_condition_to_advance: All checkpoint conditions pass; DB tables exist; Auth session works; protected routes are enforced.
